gallery.title: Photoreal Lifestyle Portrait
gallery.caption: Use short prompts to land polished, camera-aware portraits that already feel close to campaign-ready output.

gallery.title: Consistent Multi-Panel Identity
gallery.caption: Structured grids, repeated character identity, and clean panel logic make GPT-Image 2 useful for profile systems and concept boards.
gallery.prompt: Create a 2x2 portrait grid with one subject shown in four professional roles, keeping identity, lighting quality, and layout consistency intact.

gallery.title: Loose Creative Direction
gallery.caption: Move from idea to visual direction fast with sketch-like concept treatments that still feel intentional and presentation-ready.

gallery.title: Clean 3D Brand Mascot

faqs.question: Why send paid traffic to /model/gpt-image-2 instead of a single workflow page?
faqs.answer: This page keeps the intent clear at the model level first, then lets visitors choose between generation and editing without losing context or needing a second landing page hop.

faqs.question: What kinds of outputs fit GPT-Image 2 best here?
faqs.answer: The page is tuned around practical commercial output categories: ad visuals, UI concepts, product imagery, photoreal portraits, graphic systems, and revision-heavy image edits.

faqs.question: Does the page use the same production surface as Creator?
faqs.answer: Yes. The main workbench is the shared Creator flow, so prompts, comparisons, and follow-up production all continue inside the same interaction model.

scenes.title: Scene 01 · Prompt-first image generation
scenes.description: Use GPT-Image 2 when you need ad visuals, UI concepts, product hero shots, or polished stills from short natural prompts.
scenes.spotlight: Best for high-intent traffic that wants to try the model immediately and see a strong first pass without over-configuring.
scenes.starterPrompt: Create a premium skincare campaign visual with a single bottle on reflective acrylic, soft directional light, restrained typography space, and a polished editorial finish.

scenes.title: Scene 02 · Structured image refinement
scenes.description: Switch into Image Edit when the job is to clean up layouts, retouch photoreal assets, restyle screenshots, or tighten an existing visual direction.
scenes.spotlight: Best for production-minded revisions where preserving the core composition matters as much as improving the finish.
scenes.starterPrompt: Keep the existing composition, clean the layout hierarchy, refine lighting and texture, simplify distracting elements, and make the result feel like a finished campaign asset.
